svg.title: Pooling scale and alignment in MSCA-Lite
svg.desc: The three columns visually compare identity, pooling by two, and pooling by four. Pooling grids illustrate relative spatial size. Both pooled maps are bilinearly resized to the original 40 by 40 resolution before averaging. The mean drives a sigmoid energy gate, while the original input supplies the value path.
svg.metadata: Revision 44, Figure 4. Scientific source: MSCA_Lite.py and manuscript equations (1)–(2). Paper figure references: local academic-diagram atlas, DrivoR Fig. 1 (continuous paths and inline notation), TabICL Fig. 2 (operator notation and residual wiring).

g.inkscape:label: Mean of all three aligned maps
